text: 周五（7月31日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨6.15个基点，报4.7347%，本周累计上涨5.76个基点，7月份累计上涨25.56个基点，整体持续震荡上行，交投于4.4534%-4.7450%区间，北京时间8月1日01:47逼近2025年1月14日顶部4.8069%、2023年10月23日顶部5.0187%。 两年期美债收益率涨4.53个基点，报4.2912%，临近结束交易时短线从4.26%附近拉升至4.29%上方，本周累跌3.94个基点、绝大部分时间处于下跌状态，7月份累涨11.68个基点，交投于4.1018%-4.3683%区间。
text_en: Friday (July 31) New York close: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 6.15 basis points to 4.7347%, up 5.76 bps on the week and up 25.56 bps in July, continuing a choppy upward trend, trading in a 4.4534%-4.7450% range, approaching the January 14, 2025 high of 4.8069% and the October 23, 2023 high of 5.0187% around 01:47 Beijing time August 1. Two-year Treasury yield rose 4.53 bps to 4.2912%, briefly climbing from around 4.26% to above 4.29% near session end, down 3.94 bps on the week and mostly declining, up 11.68 bps in July, trading in a 4.1018%-4.3683% range.
